prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite source sheet for ANIMOL Echo Theater top-down puzzle.
Input image: provided theater detail sprite sheet is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create NEW artwork.
Primary request: two distinct complete theater scenery props, vertically separated on a transparent 1536x1536 canvas with at least 120px empty gutter and no labels. TOP HALF: a wide three-panel scenery flat on one unified burgundy wooden rectangular floor base, squarely facing camera; 3:1 footprint, cream-gold timber frame, dark plum painted angular mountain silhouettes, coral geometry, no stars. This is one 3-cell-wide whole set, not a cropped repeat. BOTTOM HALF: a coherent square 2x2-footprint backstage props storage group on a dark wood square platform: 3 different angular theater trunks, a suitcase, a rolled scenic backdrop and a draped folded burgundy fabric; arranged together, no random tiny debris.
Style: match reference thick crisp almost-black navy outlines, flat clean cel shading only base/shadow/highlight, chunky wedges, trapezoids, long straight edges, sharply chamfered corners, burgundy, plum, warm wood, ivory and gold. Strong readable silhouettes; no round inflated forms. Straight-on orthographic game prop view from slightly above, square top-down ground plane with short front face, never isometric diamond. Base front and rear edges stay horizontal, left and right edges stay vertical. The complete group silhouette should occupy almost entire width of its own rectangular base.
Transparency: genuinely transparent alpha outside each prop, no white/colored background, no checkerboard drawn in art. Keep all feet, trims, edges and base fully visible, 100px outside margins. No text, digits, logos, people, interface, arrows, gradients, painterly texture, grain, airbrush, 3D gloss.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite source sheet for a top-down theater puzzle game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; create NEW artwork.
Create TWO DISTINCT complete decorative props, separated vertically on a transparent square canvas, generous empty gutters, no labels.
TOP HALF: one wide low theater-mask display cabinet on a 2:1 rectangular wood base. Ivory comedy and tragedy masks mounted in gold angular frames at left and right, small central folded burgundy fabric. A unified two-cell-wide stage prop, not a one-cell mask stand copied twice. Cabinet top is visible, dark plum recessed panels, ivory/gold angular carving, gold capped feet.
BOTTOM HALF: one square 2x2-floor-footprint backstage marionette storage station: a broad burgundy-and-wood open chest, 3 small clearly inanimate cloth marionettes hung on a horizontal rack behind it, folded striped fabrics inside the chest, angular gold side braces, coherent square rectangular wooden platform. These are stored props, no living character poses, no faces looking toward camera. Doll heads simple faceted shapes, no neon eyes. Show platform depth enough to read as two floor cells wide and two deep.
Match reference graphic design: bold crisp near-black navy contours with thinner inner lines, long straight lines, pointed wedges and trapezoids, sharply chamfered corners. Flat 2–3 tone cel shading per material. Burgundy, plum, warm wood, ivory, rich restrained gold; tiny muted teal detail allowed. No grain, no glow, no gradients, no painterly rendering, no glossy3D.
View straight-on from above with visible square floor base and a short front face. Ground-base rear/front edges horizontal and side edges vertical, no diamond isometric perspective. Fully show whole feet, props, base and top; 80px exterior margins. Alpha transparent background, no text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, arrows, planets or moon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite source sheet for ANIMOL top-down theater puzzle decorations. Provided image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY.
Create TWO DISTINCT whole 2-cell-wide, 1-cell-deep theater decorative props on transparent canvas, separate top/bottom rows, wide empty gutter. Each prop on one unified rectangular two-to-one wooden/brass floor base. No labels or text.
TOP: backstage spotlight duo, two angular gold-and-burgundy stage spotlights on short stable legs attached to one long low trolley rack. Left lamp angled left, right lamp angled right; faceted ivory hexagonal lenses, no emitted beams, no round-gloss bulbs. Several short thick brackets, one folded burgundy cloth at base. Entire shape broad and low, not a pair of duplicated one-tile objects.
BOTTOM: broad three-step stage stair unit with 2:1 footprint, warm honey wood treads, dark plum risers, two small angular cream-and-brass side balusters, burgundy runner down the middle. Rear/top and front edges horizontal. Treads clearly separate as three readable flat geometric planes, no arrows. Whole compact front-access stair shape, entirely visible.
Graphic style: match very thick crisp near-black navy outline, simpler inner lines, long straight segments, wedges, trapezoids, sharp chamfered edges. Flat cel shading two or three tones per material, no gradients or texture. Palette warm wood, ivory, restrained gold, burgundy/plum. Camera straight-on slightly above with orthographic squared ground plane and short front face; no diamond isometric shape. Keep every foot, corner, step and base fully shown with wide transparent margin; isolated true alpha transparency, no checker pattern. Avoid living characters, moon/planets, text, UI, grain, airbrush, painterly shading, shiny3D.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite source atlas, eight DISTINCT small theater decorative props, 4 columns by 2 rows with wide empty transparent gutters, each separated and fully visible. No labels. The provided reference is visual STYLE ONLY, do not copy its prop layouts.
Read order left-to-right:
TOP row: (1) tall ticket stand: small cream/gold wooden lectern with burgundy ticket tray, unprinted tickets, square foot. (2) folded theater chair: one angular burgundy folding chair leaning upright, gold frame. (3) music stand: dark plum geometric sheet-music desk on ivory/gold stem and compact tripod, blank cream music sheet with no writing. (4) tall candelabra: one slim angular brass three-branch candle stand with three unlit ivory candles, tiny square base, no halos.
BOTTOM row: (5) mask pedestal: one single small comedy mask supported on low plum-and-gold square pedestal, different from a two-mask cabinet. (6) script pile: stack of three blank cream bound scripts with burgundy and teal covers and one gold ribbon, no written words. (7) sandbag stack: three faceted ochre canvas stage counterweight sacks with navy strap bands, angular polygonal folds, no amorphous bean shapes. (8) flower urn: ivory and gold square planter urn with angular plum/teal leaves and five burgundy/coral pointed flowers.
Match the reference exact strong graphic line sensibility: very thick near-black navy outlines; 2–3 flat cel tonal planes per material; long straight runs, wedges, trapezoids and sharp chamfers. Compact simple silhouettes; no delicate tiny details or grain. Warm wood/ivory/gold and burgundy/plum, restrained teal. Game view slightly from above, floor contact visible, short front faces, no diamond isometric bases.
Genuinely transparent alpha outside each object; clear empty gutters, no drawn checkerboard, no colored/black backdrop, no floor shadows extending into neighboring cells. Completely matte flat colors. No glow, no aura, no gradients, no texture, no airbrush, no 3D, no people, no stars/moon/planets, no numbers, no letters, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied spotlight-and-stairs sprite source sheet. Preserve the two existing complete props, their silhouettes, angular shape, burgundy/gold/ivory/wood palette, placement, relative scale, crisp navy contours and stair details. Change only the background and soft effects: remove ALL diffuse glow, aura, fog, translucent lighting, drop-shadow wash and gradients outside the silhouettes. Make every exterior pixel truly transparent alpha. Keep both objects as crisp matte flat cel shaded sprites, 2–3 flat tones per material, no blur. Remove shiny lighting and any soft gradient inside the broad color areas, using flat cel planes. Keep top spotlight trolley and bottom stage steps isolated with a clear large transparent gutter and margins. No text or additions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game sprite, a FOLDED CLOSED theater chair, for a top-down theater puzzle. Supplied reference sheet is style reference only. Draw a burgundy folding chair with gold frame in its fully folded storage position: back and seat planes pressed together vertically, front and rear legs nearly parallel and closed, thin tall upright silhouette leaning slightly. Clearly folded, NOT an open chair with horizontal seat. Ivory/gold hinge at side; small dark-plum rubber feet. Thick near-black navy outlines, angular chamfered rectangular forms, long straight lines, simple flat cel shading with 2–3 tones, no gradients or grain. Show the whole object including feet and folded top with generous transparent margins. Camera straight-on slightly above, short depth, no isometric diamond. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow haze, glow, text, people, stars, moon, planets, checkerboard or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied theater storage-pile game sprite. Keep the identity, burgundy/plum/gold/ivory/wood palette, thick near-black navy cartoon outlines, matte flat cel shading and trunk/scenery-storage subject. REDESIGN ITS FLOOR ARRANGEMENT to fill a genuine SQUARE two-cells-wide by two-cells-deep ground footprint.
The existing pile is too wide and shallow. Replace that shallow base with a deep SQUARE DECK seen from a HIGH TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC game camera, rectangular top plane with vertical left/right edges and horizontal front/back edges. The deck itself must be roughly equal pixel width and height, not a diamond or shallow trapezoid. Arrange storage items into TWO CLEAR DEPTH ROWS: the back row has a broad burgundy closed trunk at left and a tall plum wardrobe case plus rolled cream scenery flats at right; the front row has a low plum trunk at left and cream suitcase plus folded burgundy cloth at right. Put one extra small narrow crate in the central depth gap. The full SQUARE deck and dense props must occupy nearly the entire square sprite footprint with no empty upper row, no huge transparent padding inside the group. The wooden square base extends across the whole width and depth, even behind the rear trunks, with short dark-plum front riser and small gold corner caps.
Keep all side/front/back deck corners visible, no cropping. Slight object overhang allowed only above rear edge. Do not simply make the trunks taller; the BACK-TO-FRONT FLOOR AREA must be two rows deep. Crisp geometric angular silhouette, long straight edges and sharply cut chamfers, broad flat cel color blocks with only two or three tones. NO gradients, grain, texture, glow or volumetric 3D.
One coherent square group isolated on genuine transparent alpha with only a narrow empty exterior margin. No other props or panels in the sheet, no people, words, labels, arrows, grid, checkerboard background, moon or planets.
